g.text: GROOVES › swing 58 llamatron set: minimal_techno.yml ○ saved
Each cell is 1/16 of a whole note. An amount is a percentage of a cell: + plays late, - plays early.
The row repeats from the start of each scene, and a note takes the amount of the cell its time falls in.
A factory groove, which cannot be changed. C on the Grooves page copies it to one you can edit.
